title: 數母音
question:
請輸入一個小寫的英文單字，數一數裡面有幾個母音（a、e、i、o、u），輸出母音的個數。
提示：用迴圈一個字一個字看，判斷 單字[i] = "a" or 單字[i] = "e" or …，是母音就把次數加 1。

test_case.note: a 和 e 是母音

en.title: Count the Vowels
en.question:
Input a word in small letters. Count the vowels (a, e, i, o, u) in it. Output the number.
Tip: Use a loop to check each letter. Is word[i] = "a" or word[i] = "e" or ...? If yes, add 1 to the count.
